title: Atom as an Agent: Emergent Order by Collective Predictive Coding
abstract: arXiv:2610.36673v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: What is the intrinsic reason of emergence of macroscopic order parameter out of microscopic systems? In this article, we apply to physics the collective predictive coding (CPC), the theory of language/symbol emergence. As our language emerges out of our human communications, physical macroscopic order parameter emerges out of communications among atoms --- each atom is regarded as an agent who predicts each other's behavior through inference. We present three examples of classical spin systems: two-dimensional ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic Ising models, a two-dimensional spin model with competing stripe orders, and the fully connected Sherrington--Kirkpatrick spin-glass model. In all of these examples, proper macroscopic order parameters including the replica overlap emerge automatically through communication informatics of CPC, only from observed spin configurations. We call the learned macroscopic coordinate the collective pred

translated_title: 原子作为智能体：集体预测编码产生的涌现秩序
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.36673v1 公告类型：交叉。摘要：宏观序参量从微观系统中涌现的内在原因是什么？本文将集体预测编码（CPC）——一种关于语言/符号涌现的理论——应用于物理学。正如人类语言从人际交流中涌现一样，物理系统的宏观序参量也从原子之间的“交流”中涌现出来——每个原子被视为一个智能体，通过推断来预测彼此的行为。我们给出了三个经典自旋系统的例子：二维铁磁和反铁磁伊辛模型、具有竞争条纹序的二维自旋模型，以及全连接的Sherrington–Kirkpatrick自旋玻璃模型。在所有这些例子中，包括副本重叠在内的恰当宏观序参量，仅凭观测到的自旋构型，便能通过CPC的通信信息学自动涌现。我们将学习到的宏观坐标称为集体预……（原文此处截断）
tldr: 该论文将语言符号涌现的“集体预测编码”理论引入物理学，把原子视为相互预测的智能体，仅凭观测到的自旋构型就能自动涌现出伊辛模型、条纹序模型和自旋玻璃系统中的宏观序参量，为宏观秩序的起源提供了新解释。
en_tdlr: This paper applies collective predictive coding to physics by treating each atom as an agent that predicts others' behavior, demonstrating that macroscopic order parameters—including replica overlap in spin glasses—emerge automatically from observed spin configurations alone, offering a new explanation for the origin of emergent order.
